newsitem.title: USA: GATX to redeem convertible preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: GATX to redeem convertible preferred stock.

text.p: GATX Corp said Friday it called for redemption all of the outstanding shares of its $3.875 cumulative convertible preferred stock on June 16.
The convertible preferred stock will be redeemed for $51.1625 a share plus accrued dividends from May 1 through the redemption date of $0.4951 a share, for a total redemption price of $51.6576.

Each share of convertible preferred stock can be converted into 1.1494 shares of GATX common stock until 1700 EDT/2100 GMT June 16. dividends for the period commencing May 1 will be paid on preferred shares converted into common stock.
Holders of the preferred stock must convert to common stock before 1700 EDT/2100 GMT June 13 to be eligible for the quarterly dividend on common stock of $0.46 a share, which is payable June 30.
All shares not surrendered for conversion prior to 1700 EDT/2100 GMT on June 16 will be redeemed.

GATX has entered into a standby agreement with Salomon Brothers Inc. Subject to certain conditions, Salomon Brothers will purchase from GATX the number of shares of common stock that would have been issued upon conversion of shares of the convertible preferred stock that are not converted.
GATX said it expects conversion of the preferred stock will result in cash flow savings and improved capital structure.
